died.name: Laurence Saunders
died.cause: kissing the stake at which he was to be burned
died.last_words: Welcome the cross of Christ! welcome everlasting life!

died.name: Mary, Queen of Scots
died.cause: quoting Jesus prior to execution by beheading after being found guilty for plotting to assassinate her first cousin once removed, Elizabeth I of England The 44-year-old queen of Scotland was told that she was to be executed for plotting the assassination of her cousin, Queen Elizabeth I. However, when the executioner, only known as Bull, prepared to chop off her head with an axe, the first blow did not kill Mary. It only hit her head. The second blow severed her neck, but the tendon was still left. The executioner later pulled off Mary's head only to reveal that her hair was a wig.
died.last_words: O Lord, into Thy hands I commend my spirit.

died.name: Alexis of Russia
died.last_words: I would never have married had I known that my time would be so brief. If I had known that, I would not have taken upon myself double tears.

died.name: Bob Collins
died.cause: final radio transmission during 2000 Zion mid-air collision
died.last_words: Five zula alpha just had a midair. Both planes are going down in the, ah, one mile to the, ah, two miles to the west of the power plant.

born.name: Constantine XI
born.cause: Byzantine Empire, before charging into Ottoman lines during the Fall of Constantinople, he was never seen again
born.last_words: God forbid that I should live as an Emperor without an Empire. As my city falls, I will fall with it. Whosoever wishes to escape, let him save himself if he can, and whoever is ready to face death, let him follow me.

born.name: Agrippa d'Aubigné
born.desc: French poet, soldier, propagandist and chronicler
born.last_words: It comes at last, the happy day: Let thanks be given to God in heaven, while we learn pleasure in His way.

born.name: Barnard Elliott Bee Jr.
born.desc: Confederate general of the American Civil War
born.cause: before being mortally wounded at the First Battle of Bull Run. His last words gave rise to the nickname of Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson
born.last_words: There is Jackson standing like a stone wall! Rally behind the Virginians. Let us determine to die here and we will conquer. Follow me.

born.name: Thomas Selfridge
born.cause: Thomas Selfridge and Orville Wright were presenting the 1908 Wright Military Flyer to the US Army Signal Corps Division at Fort Myer. The plane made 41⁄2 rounds around the Fort before running into problems and crashing. Selfridge fractured his skull and died three hours later, becoming the first person to die in the crash of a powered aircraft.

born.name: John U. D. Page
born.desc: United States Army officer and Medal of Honor recipient
born.cause: prior to being killed in action during the Battle of Chosin Reservoir in the Korean War

born.name: Burton Abbott
born.cause: to prison physician Dr. David Schmidt prior to execution by gas chamber
born.last_words: I can't admit it, Doc. Think of what that would do to my mother. She could not take it.

born.name: James Dean
born.cause: to his friend Rolf Wütherich, moments before the car crash
born.last_words: That guy's gotta stop... He'll see us.
